headline: La disponibilidad de vivienda no siempre implica asequibilidad
summary: Mexico's housing access challenge goes beyond building new units, according to the article. Over the past decade, property prices have risen faster than household incomes, weakening purchasing power even in markets with ample supply.
why: Housing affordability affects consumer spending, mortgage demand and the lending activity of banks and developers. It is a key macro indicator for real estate investors.
